data.comment:
# Comfy Chatter Box- Multilingual Text-to-Speech with Voice Cloning

Upload a short voice sample and input your text prompt. Select a target language to generate spoken audio in multiple languages using the cloned reference voice. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs a COMFY_API_KEY.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/audio-chatterbox_tts_multilingual.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.text:
Hola amigos, bienvenidos de nuevo a ComfyUI.
Hoy vamos a explorar Chatterbox, un flujo de trabajo de clonación de voz capaz de manejar múltiples voces y múltiples idiomas.
